name: ai-key-gateway
description: AI Key Gateway - API Proxy with Token Tracking

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,admin,user" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:user"
scripts.start:bg: cd backend && cross-env SERVE_FRONTEND=true NODE_ENV=production node src/index.js > logs/npm-start.log 2>&1
scripts.start:win: cd backend && start /b cross-env SERVE_FRONTEND=true NODE_ENV=production node src/index.js
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n "backend,admin,user" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:user"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-admin && npm install && cd ../frontend-user && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend-admin && npm run build && cd ../frontend-user && npm run build
